thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we promised concrete owners/timelines for rollout safety items after yesterday's incident. Can we triage now?

kira: I can take ownership of the auto-rollback tuning doc. Want to split into immediate mitigations vs longer-term detection work.

priya: I'll own the blast-radius controls (feature flag scoping + UI guardrails). Plan: prototype a 'blast_radius_limit' flag attribute this week.

michael: I'll handle telemetry gaps — specifically the missing early indicators for sampling drift. Will add dashboards and alert thresholds.

alex: Nice. Concrete asks: 1) auto-rollback thresholds & test plan 2) flag scoping + opt-in guardrails 3) telemetry + enriched signals 4) post-deploy canary sampling audit. Assign owners and dates.

kira: For auto-rollback: short-term — hard caps by error-rate and latency (ETA EOD Fri). Long-term — ML-based anomaly detector (ETA 3w). I'll open PRs and a runbook section.

priya: Blast radius work: prototype 'blast_radius_limit' attribute on flags (e.g., percent, user cohorts, region). PoC PR by Tue. Then UX guardrail (block >50% without 2FA) — target next sprint.

michael: Telemetry: add per-flag sampling histograms, rolling p95/P99, and sampling-distribution drift alert. Dashboard by Wed, alert playbook by next Mon.

tanvi: I'll coordinate QA for the canary audit. Running the sampling audit across last 6 months, flag-by-flag, and produce a risk list. Deliverable: CSV + top 10 risky flags by Thu.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: New canary rollouts detected at 2024-09-10T14:03Z — linking to incident-3821.

alex: Good. A couple of cross-cutting items: - Add automated rollback unit tests into the rollout CI (simulate traffic spike + errors). - Add a metadata field on flags: 'safety_owner' and 'min_canary_size'.

kira: Agreed. For CI tests I'll add a fixture that replays the incident pattern (small script):
```
# simulate surge
for i in range(1000):
  call_feature(flag='new_reco', user=rand_user(), error=rand_error())
```
That will live under eng-platform/test/rollouts.

priya: For the flag metadata I propose this schema: 'blast_radius_limit': "10%|cohort|region:eu-west" and 'min_canary_size': "1000-requests". Will draft the migration plan.

michael: Telemetry note: we need to surface the canary sampling fraction in the console API so SRE can query it in alerts — I'll add an API field 'canary_sampling_fraction'.

alex: Ownership + deadlines recap: kira (auto-rollback short-term) — EOD Fri; kira (detector) — 3w; priya (blast_radius PoC) — Tue, UX guardrail next sprint; michael (dashboards) — Wed, alert playbook Mon; tanvi (canary audit) — Thu. I'll put these in the postmortem follow-ups board and tag owners.

priya: One open question: should we default new flags to 'min_canary_size=1%' and require product approval to increase?

kira: I lean yes for safety, but we need an escape hatch for performance experiments. Maybe a two-step approval: product + infra sign-off.

alex: Let's do default conservative + documented escalation. Priya, add that to the PR.

michael: Also propose a recurring quarterly 'flag hygiene' job — automated audit that emails owners for flags with high variability or >6 months unreviewed. I can prototype in 2w.

tanvi: QA will scrub the list and mark critical ones for emergency rollback tests.

ops-bot: reminder: postmortem action created — PM-3821-FOLLOWUPS assigned to alex, due 2024-09-20.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll create the follow-up board items and link the relevant PRs/notes. Quick check: anything blocking the short-term auto-rollback changes?

kira: Only dependency is the CI fixture path — merging that first. I'll open the PR now.

priya: No blockers on my side. UX review booked for next Tue.

michael: No blockers. I'll start dashboard skeleton immediately.

alex: Great. We'll reconvene Friday 9am to verify EOD items. :thumbsup:
